Kranz, N. and Worrell, E. (2001). Effects of a Shortened Depreciation Schedule on the Investment Costs for Combined Heat and Power Systems. Report LBNL-49518, Ernest Orlando Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, November 2001. No DOI printed.

31-page policy-finance paper; locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 1 at most; cover page unnumbered). Only technology-level content is Table 1 (p.16): ONSITE Energy Corp. capital cost build-up for six gas-turbine CHP sizes (1, 5, 10, 25, 40, 100 MW; the 100 MW case adds a steam turbine generator). Loaded as one example per size: total plant cost (absolute and per kW, total-plant basis), total equipment cost per kW (equipment basis), lifetime 15 y and 8000 h/yr as printed ASSUMPTIONS. No efficiency, heat output, or O&M numbers are printed (O&M is mentioned but only enters Table 2 / Figures as a combined $/kWh cost after depreciation tax shield; those go to other-values). Traps: (1) Sect. 4 says a 7% discount rate on tax shields but the Discount Rate paragraph says 15%; neither is a technology parameter and neither is loaded. (2) Price year not stated; 2001 used. (3) Table 1 column header "40" total engineering line prints 819,436 vs 819,463 for facilities (typo in source), total plant cost used as printed. Depreciation scenarios, tax shields and Treasury cost estimates (Tables 2-3) are policy results and not loaded.
